Q: how to get updateable sheet name A:

CELL is the way to go in this case

=CELL("ADDRESS", Sheet2!A1)

this will output:

Sheet2!$A$1

and get auto updated as per request, but obviously we need to treat it by stripping the range part with a simple regex, and foolproof it for greater flexibility. lets try like this:

=IFERROR(LET(x, CELL("ADDRESS", 'a b'!5000000:5000000), 
 y, REGEXEXTRACT(x, "^(?:'([^']*(?:''[^']*)*)'|([^!]+))!"), 
 SUBSTITUTE(IF(LEN(y), y, INDEX(y,2)), "''", "'")), 
 "sheet does not exist")

it supports:

  • auto update after sheet rename

  • surviving common adding of rows

  • surviving common deleting of rows

  • surviving common adding of columns **

  • surviving common deleting of columns

  • displaying notification if sheet gets deleted

  • regaining full functionality if sheet gets recreated

  • all sheet names other than active sheet

  • sheet name of the active sheet ***

  • standard sheet name

  • name with space

  • name from spaces only

  • non-latin name

  • numeric name

  • date name

  • legacy date name

  • back quote name

  • single quote name

  • two-single quote name

  • multi-single quote name

  • word in single quote

  • leading single quote

  • trailing single quote

  • single quote in the middle

  • multi-single quotes all over

  • double quote name

  • two double quote name

  • crazy quote name

  • double quoted long name

  • parenthesis name

  • name with legacy symbols

  • name with unicode symbols

  • regex unfriendly symbols

  • time name

  • tofu name

  • zero-width name

  • cell notation name

  • range notation name

  • arabic R > L name

  • formula name

  • exotic formula name

  • emoji name

** instead of !50000000:50000000 you can use shorter !III:III. in general you want the range to not be colored and also avoid using the end of the spectrum !ZZZ:ZZZ due to conviviency (not a limitation) - fun fact time! >> if you would use !ZZZ:ZZZ and add one or more columns anywhere to that sheet (even if that sheet has only one single column) you would enter the undocumented raelm of shadowland where your reference would change to !:. surprisingly nothing would break (even after F5 reload) unless you try to edit the cell holding that formula (in such case it would #ERROR! out)

*** the CELL fx is unable to read the sheet name of an active sheet. for this we need a small workaround: create some side sheet for example call it shadow then paste this fx into A1: =CELL("ADDRESS", Sheet1!50000000:50000000) where Sheet1 is the name of the active sheet. next you can remove all empty cells and hide the sheet for forever:

in active sheet use a modified fx:

=IFERROR(LET(x, shadow!A1, 
 y, REGEXEXTRACT(x, "^(?:'([^']*(?:''[^']*)*)'|([^!]+))!"), 
 SUBSTITUTE(IF(LEN(y), y, INDEX(y,2)), "''", "'")), 
 "sheet does not exist")

demo sheet

  • for alternative syntax variant see: https://stackoverflow.com/a/73767720/

  • zero width character usage: https://stackoverflow.com/a/73967098/

  • for detecting the leading single quote: possible via custom script

Q: Meteor reactive-var package is missing the equals() method, is this a bug? A:

The reason there's no equals method for ReactiveVar is because set only invalidates the computations is the new value differs from the current value.

Sets the current value of the ReactiveVar, invalidating the Computations that called get if newValue is different from the old value.

const example = new ReactiveVar(0);

Tracker.autorun(() => {
  console.log(example.get());
});

example.set(1); // logs 1
example.set(0); // logs 0
example.set(0); // doesn't log

This is similar behaviour to ReactiveDict's equals method.

Note that set on ReactiveDict does not behave this way. Calling set broadcasts that the value has changed. If you want to prevent the computation from invalidating, that is when you would use equals.

Set a value for a key in the ReactiveDict. Notify any listeners that the value has changed (eg: redraw templates, and rerun any Tracker.autorun computations, that called ReactiveDict.get on this key.)

Q: VB: how to compare two objects to find out if the values of their properties are the same? A:

The 2 objects you are comparing will not equal each other even if their properties do. You need to specify that you are comparing their properties.

Change

If vehicleStatistic.Equals(previousObject) Then
        Dim sadXml = "do something"
End If

To

If vehicleStatistic.GetType().GetProperties.Equals(previousObject.GetType().GetProperties) Then
        Dim sadXml = "do something"
End If

This way you are comparing their properties.
